title: Research: prove the dependent P112 reader floor
body:
## Summary

```diff
 literal PR3370 fitting matrix, actual complete-plane reader tariff
- PR3414: independent three-query pair replacements
+ dependent triples, including zero/proportional queries and arbitrary readers
+ finite rank-two lists with at most three projective query directions
 sharp pair floor m_A + m_B; disjoint replacements keep total tariff 224
```

The new all-field proof maps up to three projective query directions to binary directions while fixing occurring axes, then chooses each reader within the original active direction classes. Rank subadditivity and the retained expanded-I224 argument prove the sharp floor. The combined all-three-query conclusion explicitly inherits PR3414 at `7b698dc958695d0a788327ddf8866b10a59e4c37`; its independent-query theorem is not independently replayed here.

Only `research/p112-dependent-reader-floor/` is added. It contains the proof, source pins, unchanged attributed PR3370 certificate, exact receipts, two implementations, controls and bounded replay. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19009363).

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3414 left dependent lists open. **After:** arbitrary finite rank-two lists using at most three directions have the sharp actual-reader floor over every coefficient field. This closes the dependent-three-query case.
- Ninety-six exact rational literal operators and binary replacements pass 2,408,448 entry checks, including repeated directions and readers cancelling outside the target. The separate implementation checks 133 direction sets and 23,637 coefficient tuples over F2,F3,F5,F7, all 50,176 expanded-I224 entries and the literal tariff 224.
- Five behavioral groups include five actual optimized CLI corruptions and a restored positive run. Registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized 3.15 checks, Ruff, committed-byte/source-history checks and the committed Git-free export pass. The initial read-only export exposed inherited read-only modes in control copies; an ordinary follow-up commit changes copies to copyfile without changing source modes, proof or mathematical receipts.
- A separate twelve-site abstract example rejects all 256 binary maps for four directions. It limits this proof method; it is outside the literal P112 pair fixture and supplies no lower-cost witness.

Replay from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/p112-dependent-reader-floor
```

Credit Tekalign/PR3370, Nick Petalas/PR3414/PR3398, Philippe Van Velzen/PR3345, PR3383, PR3407, Matarener/Mark and the retained E8/P112/native/compiler/supplier lineage. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

This scoped obstruction supplies no native implementation, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Four or more directions, external query dimensions, changed matrices and physical/compiler/analytic obligations remain open. Selected cold replay, historical heavy suites, Lean, Docker and hosted CI are not claimed.
